visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a highly specialized, medium-sized mosasaur with a deep, powerful tail.
visual_logic.environment: High-albedo 'Chalky White' water backdrop for maximum contrast.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE; intense backlighting to emphasize the downward-curved tail vertebrae.
